description: Source code for handling Opus audio headers, including parsing, writing, and buffer management, within the Android Open Source Project.

methods.name: ReadLE16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from data at a specified offset.

methods.name: ParseOpusHeader
methods.description: Parses an Opus header from a data buffer into an OpusHeader structure.

methods.name: WriteOpusHeader
methods.description: Writes an OpusHeader structure into a buffer, generating the header bytes.

methods.name: WriteOpusHeaders
methods.description: Generates complete Opus headers including codec delay and seek pre-roll markers.

methods.name: IsOpusHeader
methods.description: Checks if a data buffer contains an Opus header marker.

methods.name: GetOpusHeaderBuffers
methods.description: Extracts buffers for Opus header, codec delay, and seek pre-roll from a data buffer.
